svg.title: HTTP request: method, path, version and host.
svg.desc: A bounded curl HTTP/1.1 request to https://example.com/ uses verbose stderr output. Selected request lines show GET / HTTP/1.1 and Host: example.com. GET requests a resource, / is the root URL path rather than filesystem root, HTTP/1.1 is the protocol version, and a blank line ends the headers. Wire lines use CRLF. Other headers are omitted, and curl's display prefixes are not part of the request.
svg.text: --http1.1 chooses the version; -v shows headers; timeout is 5 seconds.
Selected outgoing request lines, not shell commands; display prefixes omitted:
Other headers omitted; a blank line ends the headers.
GET asks for a resource. / is the URL's root path, not filesystem root.
Wire lines end in \r\n: carriage return + newline (CRLF).
Verbose output uses stderr; it can expose credentials. Check before sharing.
